methodologyNotes: Re-verified via WebFetch on official pricing pages on 2026-06-15: Pendo (pendo.io/pricing), WalkMe (walkme.com/pricing), Userpilot (userpilot.com/pricing), Appcues (appcues.com/pricing), Chameleon (chameleon.io/plans), Whatfix (whatfix.com/pricing), UserGuiding (userguiding.com/pricing). Userflow's pricing page returned HTTP 403, so its figures were corroborated via Apty, G2, and UserGuiding's pricing blog. Pendo, WalkMe, Appcues, and Whatfix publish no paid-plan prices (all require sales contact) -> monthlyUsd null. Chameleon's official Startup price is $279/mo billed annually (the draft's $333/mo and $4,000/yr could not be confirmed on the live page or any third-party source and were removed; multiple 2026 sources and Vendr confirm $279/mo = $3,348/yr). UserGuiding annual rates $174/$349 confirmed on the live page; monthly-billing rates corrected to $290/$580 (draft's $249/$499 were wrong) and annual discount corrected to ~40% (draft said 30%). Userpilot Starter $299/mo (annual) confirmed; Growth/Enterprise are custom. Userflow Startup $300/$240 and Pro $850/$680 (20% annual discount) confirmed via corroborating sources. All accessedAt = 2026-06-15.

plans.name: Ultimate

vendors.provenance: Pricing fetched from chameleon.io/plans on 2026-06-15. vendors.name: UserGuiding

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Unlimited MAUs. Adds SOC2/GDPR/HIPAA compliance certifications, SAML SSO, activity logs, personalized coaching, unlimited seats. Custom pricing.
